Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan celebrated his 61st birthday by releasing 'Tu Mil Jaaye', the opening song from his upcoming feature film 'King'. Family members, industry colleagues, and fans offered widespread public tributes to mark the milestone.

His daughter Suhana Khan shared a poster of 'King' on Instagram to wish her father a happy birthday. Other prominent Bollywood figures, including Kajol, Kareena Kapoor Khan, Shilpa Shetty, Anil Kapoor, and Karan Johar, posted congratulatory messages highlighting his enduring career and fitness.

Outside his residence, Mannat, large crowds of admirers gathered to celebrate the actor amidst decorations featuring visuals from his upcoming movie. The newly released romantic track 'Tu Mil Jaaye' features Shah Rukh Khan alongside Deepika Padukone, with vocals by Arijit Singh and Madhubanti Bagchi, composition by Sachin-Jigar, and an English rap contribution by Ed Sheeran.

Directed by Siddharth Anand, 'King' is scheduled for a worldwide cinematic release on December 24, 2026. The film's cast includes Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, Rani Mukerji, and Anil Kapoor, positioning it as a major holiday season release.

stories.title: Coach Nolberto Solano Targets SAFF Cup Semi-Finals for Pakistan Football Team
stories.summary:
Pakistan football team head coach Nolberto Solano has challenged his squad to rise to the occasion as they prepare for a high-stakes group clash against arch-rivals India in the SAFF Championship 2026. Speaking at a press conference in Islamabad, Solano emphasized that every fixture must be approached as a final, with reaching the semi-finals serving as the team's primary objective in the tournament.

Pakistan finds itself in Group B alongside traditional rivals India and the Maldives, while Group A features Bangladesh, Bhutan, and Sri Lanka. Solano likened the intense Pakistan-India rivalry to the historic football clashes between his home country Peru and Chile, acknowledging the immense expectations of passionate fans. The opening match against India is scheduled for November 5, followed by a crucial encounter against the Maldives.

Solano admitted that Pakistan will compete without its overseas-based diaspora players during the initial stages because the tournament does not fall within a FIFA international window. However, he stressed that this creates an opportunity to assess local talent without making excuses. His tactical approach prioritizes defensive solidity and team unity, aiming to avoid conceding goals by leaning heavily on the squad's defensive strengths.

Looking beyond the immediate tournament, Solano welcomed the announcement of a professional football league in Pakistan starting next year, highlighting the vital role of pre-season conditioning for player development. Meanwhile, opponents India have opted to send a second-string side to the competition while their senior team travels to New Zealand for friendlies. Notably, Nepal is missing the event for the first time in history due to a suspension issue.

stories.title: Reliance Industries Records Best Trading Day in Over Six Years
stories.summary:
Reliance Industries shares surged 11.6% to achieve their highest single-day gain in six and a half years. The sharp rally followed a stronger-than-expected quarterly financial report that boosted investor confidence regarding profitability within the company's oil and telecommunications divisions, offsetting ongoing weakness in its retail sector. 

Billionaire Mukesh Ambani's conglomerate reported a 40.6% increase in net profit for the September quarter, reaching 255.48 billion rupees ($2.69 billion) and surpassing analyst estimates of 214.19 billion rupees. Strong refining and petrochemical margins fueled the earnings beat, highlighting the growing contributions from the oil-to-chemicals and telecom segments while improving visibility for newer ventures like clean energy. 

Despite the positive session, Reliance shares have dropped more than 17% over the course of the year, heading toward their worst annual performance since 2011. Market experts attribute the recent stock surge to comfortable valuations following a period of trading near lower limits, as well as robust performance in crude processing and higher-value fuel exports. 

Brokerage firms praised the resilient quarterly performance, noting that Jio Platforms also contributed significantly through continued subscriber additions and margin expansion. Analysts suggest that while the strong results will support the company's stock in the short term, long-term outperformance relies on retail recovery and successful monetization of new energy investments.

stories.title: امریکہ میں وسط مدتی انتخابات سے قبل ڈیموکریٹ رہنما کی ریپبلکن حمایت پر تنازع
stories.summary:
امریکہ میں تین نومبر کو ہونے والے وسط مدتی انتخابات سے قبل انتخابی مہم کے دوران مشیگن کی سینیٹ نشست پر غیر معمولی سیاسی تنازع پیدا ہو گیا ہے۔ ڈیموکریٹک کانگریس رکن ہیلی سٹیونز، جو سینیٹ نامزدگی حاصل کرنے میں ناکام رہی تھیں، نے اپنے ہی پارٹی امیدوار عبدل السید کی مخالفت کرتے ہوئے ریپبلکن امیدوار مائیک راجرز کی حمایت کا اعلان کر دیا۔ اتوار کو ایک ویڈیو میں انہوں نے کہا کہ نفرت ان کی شناخت نہیں ہے جو انہیں اپنے ڈیموکریٹک امیدوار سے مل رہی ہے، جس پر دیگر ڈیموکریٹ رہنماؤں نے اسے قابلِ مذمت غداری قرار دیا۔

یہ انتخابات صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کی باقی ماندہ مدتِ صدارت اور کانگریس کے کنٹرول کے تعین کے لیے انتہائی اہم ہیں۔ ان انتخابات میں ایوانِ نمائندگان کی تمام 435 نشستوں اور سینیٹ کی 35 نشستوں پر ووٹنگ ہوگی، جن کے نتائج سے یہ طے ہوگا کہ کون سی سیاسی جماعت وفاقی قوانین بنانے والے اِن اداروں پر قابض ہوگی۔ اس وقت دونوں ایوانوں میں ریپبلکن پارٹی کی محدود اکثریت حاصل ہے، جبکہ اپوزیشن ڈیموکریٹس کانگریس کا کنٹرول حاصل کرنے کی کوشش کر رہے ہیں۔

موجودہ انتخابات میں ووٹرز کی بڑی توجہ کا مرکز معیشت اور مہنگائی ہے، جن میں ایندھن، خوراک اور رہائش کی بڑھتی قیمتیں شامل ہیں۔ فروری میں ایران کے خلاف شروع ہونے والی جنگ اور ٹرمپ کی ٹیرف پالیسیوں کو مہنگائی کی وجوہات میں شمار کیا جا رہا ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ سرحدی سیکیورٹی، امیگریشن اور مصنوعی ذہانت کے ضابطے بھی مہم کے اہم موضوعات ہیں۔ سلور بلیٹن کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق اکتوبر 2026 کے اوائل تک صدر ٹرمپ کی مقبولیت کی شرح کم ہو کر 37 فیصد رہ گئی ہے جبکہ 61 فیصد افراد نے ان کی کارکردگی پر عدم اطمینان ظاہر کیا ہے۔

ماضی کے رجحانات کے مطابق امریکی ووٹرز عموماً وسط مدتی انتخابات میں برسراقتدار جماعت کے خلاف ووٹ ڈالتے ہیں۔ تاہم، مشیگن سمیت کئی ریاستوں میں گورنر کے عہدوں اور اہم سینیٹ و ایوانِ نمائندگان کے حلقوں پر سخت مقابلے متوقع ہیں۔ نئی حلقہ بندیوں کے تنازعات کی وجہ سے اس بار کے انتخابی نتائج کو زیادہ غیر یقینی سمجھا جا رہا ہے، جو ملک کی قانون سازی کی سمت کا فیصلہ کریں گے۔

stories.title: Tucker Carlson Warns US May Consider Nuclear Strike on Iran
stories.summary:
American political commentator Tucker Carlson claimed in a social media post that the United States might contemplate executing a nuclear strike against Iran. According to Carlson, U.S. President Donald Trump could face intense pressure from Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu to authorize the use of nuclear weapons, with a potential decision arriving around November 7. 

Carlson pointed to Pickaxe Mountain in central Iran as a potential target, asserting that underground tunnel networks house suspected nuclear facilities that conventional military hardware cannot penetrate. He cautioned that a nuclear strike could trigger global warfare, establish a dangerous international precedent that might encourage Russia to use nuclear weapons in Ukraine, and heighten nuclear risks between India and Pakistan as well as North Korea and South Korea. Furthermore, he warned that radioactive contamination could jeopardize drinking water supplies across the Gulf region. 

Within the U.S. administration, Carlson stated that Vice President JD Vance and special envoy Steve Witkoff favor a diplomatic resolution with Tehran rather than military escalation. Conversely, he alleged that Netanyahu exerted pressure on U.S. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and Central Command leadership, while Secretary of State Marco Rubio and CIA Director John Ratcliffe support the Israeli position. 

These claims follow reports from Axios that Netanyahu and Trump spoke by phone following midterm elections, with the Israeli leader pushing for immediate military action against Iran. While Trump described the conversation as a good talk and acknowledged discussing Iran, he declined to disclose specific details.

stories.title: Pakistan and China Reaffirm Strategic Partnership During Senior Official Visit
stories.summary:
Senior Chinese official Liu Haixing met with Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif at the PM House in Islamabad on Monday. Haixing praised the ongoing momentum in high-level and party-to-party exchanges, which aim to strengthen bilateral ties.

During the discussions, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif described the bilateral ties as an ironclad, time-tested partnership founded on mutual trust and respect. The meeting included a shared focus on expanding cooperation across trade, investment, connectivity, infrastructure development, information technology, and agricultural modernisation. Prime Minister Shehbaz also hosted a banquet in honor of the visiting Chinese delegation.

Earlier in the day, Haixing met with Chief of Defence Forces and Chief of Army Staff Field Marshal Syed Asim Munir at the General Headquarters in Rawalpindi. Both military and political engagements emphasized regional security dynamics, institutional linkages, and a mutual resolve to advance the strategic cooperative partnership.

The visit coincides with the 75th anniversary of diplomatic relations between Islamabad and Beijing, which were initially established on May 21, 1951. Haixing, who heads the International Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, visited Pakistan at the invitation of Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar.

stories.title: Pakistan Cricket Board Announces 69th Quaid-e-Azam Trophy Schedule and Squads
stories.summary:
The 69th edition of Pakistan's premier first-class cricket competition, the Quaid-e-Azam Trophy, is scheduled to commence on Tuesday, November 3, across Islamabad, Abbottabad, and Rawalpindi. The tournament features a Gold tier consisting of eight teams, including defending champions Karachi Blues, alongside a 12-team Silver tier divided into two groups that serves as a qualifying pathway to the Gold tier for the upcoming season. The Gold tier matches will run from November 3 to December 12, culminating in a final between the top two teams from December 15 to 19, with all four matches live-streamed on tapmad and Tamasha. Meanwhile, the Silver tier group matches will take place from November 3 to 30 across venues in Karachi, Rahim Yar Khan, and Bahawalpur, followed by a five-day final between group toppers from December 3 to 7.

A total of 29 first-class matches will be played in the Gold tier and 31 matches in the Silver tier. Notable players are set to participate, including Pakistan Test captain Babar Azam, who will feature for Lahore Whites in the opening round against Shaheen Shah Afridi-led FATA at the Diamond Cricket Ground in Islamabad. Other teams participating across the divisions include Faisalabad, Lahore Whites, Islamabad, Peshawar, Multan, Sialkot Blues, Rawalpindi, Larkana, Quetta, Bahawalpur, Peshawar Whites, Karachi Whites, Azad Jammu and Kashmir, Hyderabad, Dera Murad Jamali, Abbottabad, and Sialkot Whites. Several squads have listed players on national duty who remain available for selection when free.

The tournament structure aims to provide extensive domestic competition across multiple regions. Group A of the Silver tier will utilize three venues in Karachi, while Group B matches are assigned to Multan Cricket Stadium, the Sports Complex in Rahim Yar Khan, and Dring Stadium in Bahawalpur. Live streaming will also cover selected matches in the Silver tier, with four out of six games per round broadcasted.

This domestic championship is significant for maintaining player readiness and identifying talent for the national side. With various star players and emerging talents distributed among the competing regional squads, the tournament acts as a major cornerstone for Pakistan's red-ball cricket calendar.

stories.title: ہنگو کے علاقے سروخیل میں گھر کے اندر فائرنگ سے دو خواتین اور تین بچوں سمیت چھ افراد جاں بحق
stories.summary:
خیبر پختونخوا کے ضلع ہنگو کے علاقے سروخیل میں ایک رہائشی مکان کے اندر فائرنگ کا ہولناک واقعہ پیش آیا جس کے نتیجے میں دو خواتین اور تین بچوں سمیت کل چھ افراد جان کی بازی ہار گئے۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق اس خونی واقعے کی فوری اطلاع ملتے ہی پولیس کی نفری موقع پر روانہ ہو گئی اور تمام لاشوں کو تحویل میں لے کر فوری طور پر قریبی اسپتال منتقل کر دیا گیا۔

ضلعی پولیس آفیسر صلاح الدین نے اس لرزہ خیز واقعے کی تصدیق کرتے ہوئے بتایا کہ پولیس نے واقعے کی باقاعدہ تفتیش اور تحقیقات کا آغاز کر دیا ہے۔ پولیس کا کہنا ہے کہ مقتولین میں کمسن بچے اور خواتین بھی شامل ہیں جو گھر کے اندر موجود تھے جب نامعلوم افراد نے فائرنگ کی۔ واقعے کے محرکات جاننے کے لیے شواہد اکٹھے کیے جا رہے ہیں۔

یاد رہے کہ ہنگو کے علاقے توغسرائے میں بھی تلخ کلامی کے نتیجے میں فائرنگ کا ایک اور واقعہ رونما ہوا تھا جس میں دو افراد لقمہ اجل بنے اور ایک شخص زخمی ہوا۔ قانون نافذ کرنے والے اداروں کا کہنا ہے کہ علاقے میں امن و امان کی بحالی اور ملزمان کی گرفتاری کے لیے چھاپے مارے جا رہے ہیں تاکہ قانون کے مطابق سخت کارروائی کی جا سکے۔

stories.title: بالی ووڈ سپر اسٹار شاہ رخ خان کا اکیاسویں سالگرہ پر مداحوں کے لیے پیغام
stories.summary:
بالی ووڈ کے معروف سپر اسٹار شاہ رخ خان نے اپنی اکیاسویں سالگرہ کے موقع پر مداحوں کی محبت اور نیک تمناؤں کا جواب ایک خصوصی ہاتھ سے لکھے پیغام کے ذریعے دیا ہے۔ ہر سال ان کی سالگرہ پر آدھی رات کو مداح ان کی رہائش گاہ 'منت' کے باہر جمع ہوتے ہیں اور اداکار کی بالکونی میں آمد کا انتظار کرتے ہیں۔

اس سال گھر کی تزئین و آرائش کے باعث یہ روایت برقرار نہ رہ سکی اور اداکار بالکونی میں آکر مداحوں کو ہاتھ ہلاتے دکھائی نہیں دیے۔ تاہم اس کے باوجود مداح رات گئے بڑی تعداد میں ان کی رہائش گاہ کے باہر موجود رہے جن کی پذیرائی کے لیے شاہ رخ خان نے منت کے باہر نصب ایک بڑے بل بورڈ پر ہاتھ سے تحریر کردہ پیغام آویزاں کیا۔

اپنے اس پیغام میں اداکار نے تمام مداحوں کی محبت اور نیک تمناؤں کا شکریہ ادا کیا اور جواب میں سب کے لیے ڈھیروں پیار کا اظہار کیا۔ پیغام کے اختتام پر انہوں نے مداحوں کو بڑی سی جپھی دینے کا ذکر کیا اور اپنے دستخط بھی ثبت کیے۔

اس موقع پر شاہ رخ خان کی رہائش گاہ کو ان کی آنے والی فلم 'کنگ' کی تشہیری تصاویر اور مناظر سے سجایا گیا تھا جن میں فلم کے دو مکالمے بھی نمایاں تھے۔ ہدایت کار سدھارتھ آنند کی یہ فلم چوبیس دسمبر دو ہزار چھبیس کو سینما گھروں میں ریلیز ہونے والی ہے جسے کرسمس کی بڑی فلموں میں شمار کیا جا رہا ہے۔

stories.title: امریکہ میں نجی طیارہ حادثہ، نو افراد ہلاک اور آخری آڈیو سامنے آ گئی
stories.summary:
امریکہ کے صوبے فلوریڈا میں ایک نجی جیٹ طیارہ رہائشی علاقے میں گر کر تباہ ہو گیا جس کے نتیجے میں سوار تمام نو افراد ہلاک ہو گئے۔ یہ حادثہ کریسٹ ہیون کے قریب اتوار کی دوپہر بارہ بج کر پچاس منٹ پر پیش آیا، جو صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کے کلب مار اے لاگو سے چودہ کلومیٹر کے فاصلے پر ہے۔ فیڈرل ایوی ایشن ایڈمنسٹریشن کے مطابق لیئرجیٹ 60 ماڈل کا یہ طیارہ آسٹن، ٹیکساس سے بہاماس جا رہا تھا۔

ایئر ٹریفک کنٹرول کے پاس محفوظ آڈیو ریکارڈنگ کے مطابق عملے کے رکن نے شدید موسم، برف باری اور طیارے کے بے قابو ہونے کی اطلاع دی۔ آخری لمحات میں پائلٹ نے بتایا کہ طیارہ فی منٹ بیس ہزار فٹ کی رفتار سے نیچے جا رہا ہے اور کاک پٹ سے آخری جملہ سنا گیا کہ ان کا وقت ختم ہو گیا ہے۔ ڈیش کیمرے کی ویڈیو میں طیارے کو تیزی سے زمین پر گرتے اور دھماکے سے آگ لگتے ہوئے دیکھا جا سکتا ہے۔

فلوریڈا کے گورنر رون ڈی سینٹس اور وزیر ٹرانسپورٹ شان ڈفی نے اس واقعے کو ہولناک قرار دیا۔ حادثے کے نتیجے میں قریبی ٹریلر پارک کے چھ سو رہائشیوں کو منتقل کرنا پڑا اور انفراسٹرکچر کو نقصان پہنچا، جبکہ حادثے کی وجوہات کی تحقیقات کے لیے ٹیمیں تشکیل دے دی گئی ہیں۔

stories.title: Bangladeshi Garment Workers Clash with Police Demanding Higher Wages
stories.summary:
Thousands of Bangladeshi garment workers blocked a major highway and clashed with police on Monday, demanding a monthly minimum wage of 30,000 taka, which is more than double their current pay of about 13,000 taka. The protests erupted across industrial hubs in the South Asian nation of 170 million people, the world's second-biggest garment exporter behind China. In Gazipur, north of Dhaka, hundreds of workers blocked the Dhaka-Tangail highway and vandalized vehicles, while demonstrators in Mirpur and Ashulia faced police forces using tear gas and stun grenades. Angry protesters also set fire to a police vehicle during the unrest.

The demonstrations occurred despite the government's announcement on Sunday to establish a wage board to review minimum wages in the crucial garment industry, which employs millions and drives export earnings. Labour leaders stated that workers' grievances persist due to soaring inflation and rising household expenses, including food, cooking gas, and electricity bills. Factory workers like 28-year-old Mamum and 24-year-old machine operator Sharmin expressed frustration over living costs and emphasized their vital role in keeping the economy functioning. Industry representatives reported that workers from at least 529 factories in Dhaka and surrounding areas, including Savar, Jirani, and Gazipur, left their workplaces.

In response, Home Minister Salahuddin Ahmed stated that the government would deal with unlawful activities under the guise of labour movements with an iron hand. However, Ahmed also noted that Prime Minister Tarique Rahman instructed officials following an emergency cabinet meeting to ensure workers' rights and living standards while keeping production and export shipments unhindered. Manufacturer associations warned that prolonged unrest could disrupt production and affect international commitments. Labour federation general secretary Kamrul Hasan noted that some union leaders went into hiding as unexpected protests continued over unresolved issues alongside wage board formations.

stories.title: Robots Climb Sacred Mount Tai in China for Machine Endurance Test
stories.summary:
Dozens of robots recently competed in a unique race up Mount Tai, a prominent peak and UNESCO World Heritage site in China's eastern Shandong province. Organised by state broadcaster China Media Group, the World Mountain Robot Challenge tested machine endurance across a rugged 3.9-kilometer course featuring more than 600 meters of ascent and over 3,000 steps.

Participating teams from roughly 90 entities sent out machines tasked with completing the steep route rapidly or safely carrying fragile cargo such as fresh eggs and watermelons to the summit. The demanding terrain proved difficult for several competitors, resulting in mechanical failures and humanoid robots tumbling down the ancient stone steps.

Despite the rocky landscape, a four-legged canine robot manufactured by Beijing Lingyi Technology finished the course in 43 minutes and 41 seconds to secure the speed category win for quadrupedal machines. Meanwhile, the fastest humanoid robot, fielded by Beijing-based team Zhishen Lingyue, completed a shorter race track in 27 minutes and 26 seconds.

Organisers highlighted Mount Tai as a natural extreme testing ground capable of preparing robotic systems for practical, real-world deployment. Cash prizes were awarded across multiple categories, honoring both overall speed and superior load-carrying performance on the historical mountain path.

stories.title: Actor Junaid Khan Urges More Investment in Independent Music and TV
stories.summary:
Pakistani actor and musician Junaid Khan has called for increased financial investment in independent music and greater diversity in television storytelling. Discussing his career with Atiqa Odho, Khan noted that while digital platforms like YouTube and Spotify offer free streaming opportunities for younger artists, the commercial music industry lacks dedicated financial backing independent of television dramas.

Khan pointed out that historical dedicated music channels declined due to copyright challenges and the availability of free foreign content, leaving current musicians heavily reliant on drama soundtracks. He praised contemporary independent acts such as Young Stunners and Hasan Raheem for exploring creative genres outside traditional music styles.

Regarding the television sector, Khan observed that programming largely caters to a female-dominated audience based on industry research. He expressed a personal interest in seeing television broaden its scope to include male-centred narratives, action, crime, and thriller genres.

Beyond his artistic pursuits, Khan discussed balancing a five-day work week, fitness routines, and family life with his two children. He also addressed the unique challenges that media fame poses to marital relationships, emphasizing the importance of maintaining boundaries and involving partners in professional life.

stories.title: Sindh Government and World Bank Review $3.85 Billion Development Portfolio
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah and World Bank Country Director Bolormaa Amgaabazar recently met in Karachi to evaluate ongoing development initiatives valued at $3.85 billion across the province. Both officials reaffirmed their dedication to finalizing the schemes within their designated timeframes, covering sectors such as health, education, agriculture, irrigation, and urban sanitation.

During the review meeting, the chief minister urged provincial departments to eliminate administrative and financial hurdles, expedite fund disbursements, and improve inter-departmental coordination. Key discussions included the second phase of the Karachi Water and Sewerage Services Improvement Project, the restructuring of the Karachi Water and Sewerage Corporation, and preparations for water supply infrastructure associated with the K-IV project.

In the health and agricultural sectors, participants reviewed the Sindh Integrated Health and Population Project, the procurement of 104 ambulances, and the distribution of financial assistance to 249,861 farmers affected by the 2022 floods. Other topics included the Sindh Water and Agriculture Transformation Project, modernization efforts for the Guddu and Sukkur barrages, and database integration with NADRA for maternal and child support payments.

Additional discussions touched upon early-grade education initiatives under the Sindh Early Learning Enhancement through Classroom Transformation Project, livestock sector improvements, and urban transport schemes under the Karachi Mobility Project. World Bank Country Director Amgaabazar commended the provincial government's efforts and stressed the importance of robust institutional mechanisms for achieving targeted development outcomes.

stories.title: Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology Introduces Advance Appointment System for OPD
stories.summary:
The Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology has launched an advance appointment system for its Outdoor Patient Department to streamline visits and reduce prolonged wait times. Hospital authorities confirmed that patients requiring follow-up consultations for bypass procedures and angioplasty will utilize this new scheduling process.

Despite the introduction of the advance booking framework, the facility will maintain separate clinics for walk-in patients during the initial phase. Hospital administrators emphasized that no individual seeking care will be turned away without an examination, ensuring that visitors traveling from distant areas continue to receive necessary medical services.

Additionally, emergency services for cardiac patients at the Rawalpindi Institute of Cardiology will remain operational 24 hours a day without interruption. To address public grievances regarding medical services and hospital procedures, the administration has also established a dedicated complaint center on-site.

stories.title: Gold Prices in Pakistan Rise Following Global Market Trends
stories.summary:
Gold prices in Pakistan experienced an increase on Monday, reflecting upward movements in the international market. According to figures provided by the All-Pakistan Gems and Jewellers Sarafa Association (APGJSA), the price of gold per tola climbed by Rs2,400 to reach Rs412,136.

Additionally, the price for 10 grams of gold rose by Rs2,058, settling at Rs353,340. This recovery follows a notable drop on Saturday, during which the per tola price had decreased by Rs10,800 to close at Rs409,736.

Globally, the international rate of gold increased by $24, bringing the price to $3,896 per ounce. Alongside the precious metal, the local price of silver also saw an upward adjustment, growing by Rs100 to reach Rs5,488 per tola.

These adjustments track ongoing fluctuations in precious metals, providing important updates for local traders and consumers who monitor daily market valuations closely.

stories.title: Kuwait Ministry Warns Property Owners Against Hiring Illegal Security Guards
stories.summary:
Kuwait’s Ministry of Interior (MOI) has issued a caution directing property owners to refrain from hiring security guards, referred to as Haris, who lack valid residency permits and proper legal sponsorship. The advisory covers properties under construction, chalets, farms, and livestock enclosures known as jakhours, emphasizing adherence to local employment laws.

Property owners are instructed to thoroughly verify the legal status of prospective guards before employment, ensuring workers possess valid residency documents sponsored directly by the property owner or an authorized company. Authorities also advise checking for absconding reports, court judgments, or other security restrictions to avoid legal liability for violations.

In a separate enforcement update, the Public Authority for Manpower (PAM) flagged thousands of private sector employers for failing to timely disburse wages. Out of 48,408 registered business files for establishments with five or more workers, 8,849 employer files were officially flagged for salary payment violations, while 39,559 files remained fully compliant.

PAM oversees more than 100,000 total employer files, including smaller operations. The authority reiterated strict guidelines regarding payroll adjustments, noting that employers are legally permitted to make salary deductions under only 13 explicit circumstances, such as unapproved absences, refusal to work, disciplinary suspensions, and specific types of leave.

stories.title: سندھ حکومت نے کراچی سمیت صوبے بھر کی اسکول وینز میں سی این جی اور ایل پی جی سلنڈرز کے استعمال پر پابندی عائد کر دی
stories.summary:
سندھ بھر میں بچوں کی حفاظت کو یقینی بنانے کے لیے کراچی سمیت تمام اضلاع میں اسکول وینز کے اندر سی این جی اور ایل پی جی سلنڈرز کے استعمال پر سخت پابندی عائد کر دی گئی ہے۔ صوبائی وزیرِ تعلیم سید سردار علی شاہ کی خصوصی ہدایات کے بعد تمام نجی اسکولوں اور ٹرانسپورٹرز کو حفاظتی احکامات باضابطہ طور پر جاری کر دیے گئے ہیں۔

وزیرِ تعلیم نے واضح کیا کہ اسکول وینز میں خطرناک طریقوں سے پیٹرول کی فراہمی بھی قطعی ناقابل قبول ہے، اور بوتلوں یا کین کے ذریعے انجن کو پیٹرول پلانے پر بھی پابندی عائد کی گئی ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ وزیراعلیٰ سندھ سید مراد علی شاہ کی ہدایت پر اسکول وینز کے کرائے بڑھانے سے روکنے کا حکم نامہ بھی جاری کر دیا گیا ہے تاکہ والدین کو اضافی مالی بوجھ سے بچایا جا سکے۔

حکومتی احکامات کے مطابق اسکول وینز میں مقررہ گنجائش سے زائد طلبہ کو بٹھانے یا بچوں کو فٹ بورڈ پر کھڑا کر کے سفر کرانے پر مکمل پابندی ہو گی۔ اسکول ٹرانسپورٹ کے لیے سندھ حکومت کا فٹنس سرٹیفکیٹ لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے جس کی کاپی گاڑی کے اندر ہر وقت موجود ہونی چاہیے تاکہ بوقتِ ضرورت چیکنگ کی جا سکے۔

محکمۂ تعلیم سندھ نے خبردار کیا ہے کہ ان حفاظتی ہدایات اور ضوابط کی خلاف ورزی کرنے والے نجی تعلیمی اداروں اور ٹرانسپورٹرز کے خلاف سخت قانونی کارروائی عمل میں لائی جائے گی۔ حکومت کا عزم ہے کہ طلبہ کی جان اور سلامتی پر کسی قسم کا کوئی سمجھوتا نہیں کیا جائے گا۔

stories.title: Islamabad Court Sentences Man to Seven Years in Cybercrime Case
stories.summary:
An Islamabad Additional District and Sessions Court handed down a seven-year rigorous imprisonment sentence to Raja Haris Naveed in a cybercrime case involving a 16-year-old boy. Additional District and Sessions Judge Muhammad Afzal Majoka delivered the verdict on October 29 after finding the primary defendant guilty of harassment and recording an objectionable video without consent.

The conviction was executed under Section 22 relating to child pornography of the Prevention of Electronic Crimes Act (PECA) of 2016, alongside Sections 34 and 109 of the Pakistan Penal Code. Additionally, the court imposed a fine of Rs1 million under the amended 2025 PECA framework, stating that failure to pay the monetary penalty would result in an extra six months behind bars.

According to court details, the victim was a 16-year-old matriculation student who was lured into a drawing room, confined, and threatened at gunpoint while the recording took place. Meanwhile, co-accused Shahzaib Miraj was acquitted due to a lack of evidence establishing his role in assisting or abetting the offense.

The ruling follows a similar Islamabad court decision on October 22, where two men received 10-year prison terms and Rs2 million in fines each for blackmailing a 12-year-old girl and sharing her inappropriate images. That previous case was initiated by the National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency following a complaint filed by the minor victim's father.

stories.title: پی ٹی آئی کارکنوں کی گرفتاریوں کے خلاف درخواستوں پر وفاقی آئینی عدالت میں سماعت
stories.summary:
پاکستان تحریکِ انصاف کے کارکنوں کی تین ایم پی او کے تحت کی جانے والی گرفتاریوں کا معاملہ اب وفاقی آئینی عدالت میں پہنچ چکا ہے۔ عدالت نے اس حوالے سے دائر درخواستوں کو سماعت کے لیے مقرر کر دیا ہے، جن پر پانچ نومبر کو کارروائی کی جائے گی۔ چیف جسٹس امین الدین خان کی سربراہی میں دو رکنی بینچ ان مقدمات کی سماعت کرے گا، جس میں جسٹس علی باقر نجفی بھی شامل ہیں۔

یہ قانونی چارہ جوئی پشاور ہائی کورٹ کے اس عبوری حکم نامے کے بعد سامنے آئی جس کے ذریعے فریقین کی گرفتاریوں کو روکا گیا تھا۔ اس روک کے خلاف ایڈووکیٹ جنرل کے توسط سے وفاقی آئینی عدالت سے رجوع کیا گیا تھا۔ عدالت عظمیٰ تین ایم پی او سے متعلق مجموعی طور پر اڑتالیس متفرق درخواستوں پر جمعرات کے روز سماعت کرے گی۔

اس عدالت کے علاوہ ملکی سطح پر دیگر اہم سرکاری اور انتظامی امور بھی جاری ہیں۔ پنجاب کے محکمہ تعلیم کے مطابق اسکولوں کو عارضی اساتذہ کی ایڈجسمنٹ کے ذریعے کھولا گیا ہے، جبکہ نادرا حکام کی طرف سے بلاک شدہ شناختی کارڈز کی جانچ اور تصدیق کا عمل بھی تسلسل سے جاری ہے۔

دوسری جانب، سیکیورٹی کے حوالے سے لیفٹیننٹ جنرل احمد شریف چوہدری نے بتایا ہے کہ سیکیورٹی فورسز روزانہ کی بنیاد پر تقریباً دو سو انٹیلی جنس بیسڈ آپریشنز انجام دے رہی ہیں۔ اس کے علاوہ سیاسی اور انتظامی سطح پر بھی مختلف بیانات اور منصوبے سامنے آئے ہیں جن میں کراچی میں انڈسٹریل واٹر پارک کی تکمیل کا دعویٰ بھی شامل ہے۔

stories.title: لاہور میں نوکری کا جھانسہ دے کر خاتون سے زیادتی کا مقدمہ درج
stories.summary:
لاہور کے علاقے کوٹ لکھپت میں ایک خاتون کو نوکری کا جھانسہ دے کر مبینہ طور پر زیادتی کا نشانہ بنائے جانے کا واقعہ پیش آیا ہے۔ پولیس حکام کے مطابق اس واقعے کا مقدمہ عدالتی حکم پر پاکستان ریلوے کے افسران کے خلاف درج کر لیا گیا ہے۔ نامزد ملزمان میں ڈویژنل سپریٹنڈنٹ (ڈی ایس) ریلوے اور ڈپٹی ڈائریکٹر بھی شامل ہیں۔

پولیس حکام کا کہنا ہے کہ اس واقعے میں ملوث ایک ملزم کو گرفتار کر لیا گیا ہے اور اس سے فی الحال تفتیش جاری رکھی جا رہی ہے۔ جبکہ دوسرے مفرور ملزم کی تلاش کے لیے پولیس کی جانب سے کارروائیاں کی جا رہی ہیں۔

یہ مقدمہ عدالت کے جاری کردہ خصوصی حکم کے بعد باضابطہ طور پر درج کیا گیا۔ واقعے کی مزید تحقیقات متعلقہ پولیس حکام کی نگرانی میں کی جا رہی ہیں تاکہ تمام حقائق سامنے لائے جا سکیں۔

stories.title: کراچی: نو سالہ بچے کی ہلاکت کے مقدمے میں دو ملزمان بری
stories.summary:
سیشن کورٹ وسطیٰ کراچی نے نو سالہ بچے مہتاب کی ہلاکت کے ایک مقدمے کا فیصلہ سناتے ہوئے دو ملزمان کو شک کا فائدہ دیتے ہوئے بری کر دیا ہے۔ بری ہونے والوں میں ملزم عارف شامل ہیں جن پر قتل کا الزام تھا جبکہ اعجاز کو سہولت کاری کے الزام سے بری کیا گیا ہے۔

دورانِ سماعت وکیلِ صفائی کا کہنا تھا کہ ملزمان کے خلاف کسی قسم کے ٹھوس شواہد موجود نہیں ہیں اور استغاثہ کے گواہان کے بیانات میں بھی واضح تضاد پایا جاتا ہے۔ عدالت نے اپنے فیصلے میں کہا کہ استغاثہ فائرنگ کرنے والے اصل شخص کی شناخت کرانے میں مکمل طور پر ناکام رہا ہے کیونکہ گواہوں نے ملزم کو فائرنگ کرنے والے کے طور پر نہیں پہچانا۔

عدالت کے مطابق مدعی نے صرف فائرنگ کی آواز سننے کا بیان دیا تھا جبکہ تفتیشی افسر نے بھی تسلیم کیا کہ اس واقعے کا کوئی بھی عینی شاہد موجود نہیں ہے۔ اس کے علاوہ لائسنس یافتہ پستول کی ملکیت سے واردات کا ثابت ہونا بھی ناممکن رہا اور فرانزک رپورٹ میں اسلحہ اور خول کے درمیان کوئی قابلِ اعتماد تعلق ثابت نہیں ہو سکا۔ عدالت نے دونوں ملزمان پر تیس تیس لاکھ روپے جرمانہ بھی عائد کیا۔ یاد رہے کہ نومبر 2025 میں گلبرگ تھانے کی حدود میں گھر کے اندر موجود نو سالہ مہتاب کو گولی لگی تھی۔

stories.title: Pakistan Manufacturing PMI Edges Down to Six-Month Low in October
stories.summary:
The seasonally adjusted HBL Pakistan Manufacturing Purchasing Managers’ Index, compiled by S&P Global, declined slightly to 50.8 in October from 50.9 in September. Although the reading remains above the 50.0 threshold separating growth from contraction, it indicates only a marginal improvement in operational conditions for the sector.

Underlying metrics highlighted escalating inflationary risks, driven by a sharp rise in input costs that impacted production activity. Input price inflation reached its highest level since data collection began in May 2024, with survey respondents pointing primarily to elevated raw material prices, particularly fuel and fabrics. Manufacturers passed these burdens onto customers by raising selling prices at the fastest rate since April, amid challenges from high energy prices and Middle East disruptions.

New orders returned to growth following a contraction in September, aided by better product quality and a rebound in domestic demand. Conversely, export orders dropped for the first time in six months and recorded their sharpest decline in over a year due to higher prices and regional issues. Employment levels also fell for the first time since May as firms tried to manage costs.

Humaira Qamar, Head of Equities & Research at HBL, noted that business confidence fell to a three-month low due to inflation and raw material cost concerns. She added that the SBP’s recent 50 basis point rate hike to 12.0 percent demonstrates a balanced, data-dependent approach to managing economic activity against persistent inflationary and geopolitical risks.

stories.title: ADNOC Partners with OpenAI to Deploy Advanced AI in Energy Sector
stories.summary:
UAE state oil company ADNOC announced a partnership on Monday with OpenAI, marking it as the world’s first energy firm to deploy OpenAI Frontier, an advanced artificial intelligence platform. The agreement was unveiled during the UAE’s flagship oil industry event in Abu Dhabi by ADNOC managing director and CEO Sultan Al Jaber and OpenAI CEO Sam Altman.

The collaboration will integrate OpenAI's reasoning models with decades of data across thousands of wells, reservoirs, and surface facilities, alongside financial considerations, to optimize full-field development master plans. Interconnected AI agents will continuously forecast crude oil supply, demand, prices, and margins to evaluate the operational and commercial impact of decisions as a single integrated process. No financial details of the deal were disclosed.

The initiative comes as Gulf countries face oil export challenges driven by tanker targeting and blockades in the Strait of Hormuz following actions by Iran, which have caused oil prices to spike. The UAE continues to position itself as a major global player in artificial intelligence, building on national strategies initiated in 2017 and supporting entities like the G42 AI company, which is chaired by the UAE president’s brother, Sheikh Tahnoon bin Zayed Al Nahyan.

Regionally, other major energy players are also expanding their technological investments. Saudi state oil firm Aramco recently announced plans to acquire a 49 percent stake in Saudi-backed AI company Humain, injecting approximately 9.9 billion Saudi riyals ($2.6bn) along with digital and compute assets this year to scale operations.

stories.title: Federal Government Prepares PIMS Hospital Act for Parliamentary Approval
stories.summary:
The federal government is preparing to introduce a new administrative structure at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences (PIMS) following a recent fire incident at the hospital. Official sources indicate that the government plans to seek parliamentary approval for the PIMS Hospital Act during the current month. A specialized committee tasked with reviewing the hospital's administrative framework has completed its recommendations, which are set to be forwarded to the prime minister for formal approval. Ministry of National Health Services sources stated that the proposed PIMS Amendment Act will be presented in Parliament immediately afterward.

Under the proposed reforms, PIMS is expected to adopt an administrative model similar to the Medical Teaching Institution (MTI) Act. Management of the hospital would be overseen by a Board of Governors comprising representatives from various professional and social sectors. Additionally, the chairman of this Board of Governors would be selected through a market-based process. These changes aim to establish a revised governance and administrative framework for the institution.

The PIMS Reform Committee responsible for these recommendations is headed by the federal health minister and includes the federal law minister, the secretary of the Establishment Division, and the chairman of the Higher Education Commission. Furthermore, vice-chancellors of medical universities and healthcare experts were included in the committee to contribute professional input. The reform process involves submitting these suggestions first to the prime minister before introducing the amendment legislation in Parliament.

stories.title: Weak Asian Currencies Boost UAE Expat Remittances Home
stories.summary:
Expatriates in the United Arab Emirates are benefiting from weak Asian currencies, as each dirham converts into a higher amount when sent back to their home countries. The Indian rupee, Philippine peso, and Pakistani rupee are currently hovering near their weakest levels in years. The Indian rupee opened weaker against the dirham, influenced by a retreating dollar and a plunge in US Treasury yields overnight, trading at 25.95 rupees per dirham compared to 25.83 in the previous session. Consequently, expats must spend 38.71 dirhams to exchange for 1,000 Indian rupees.

At the same time, the Philippine peso weakened further against the dirham, remaining unchanged at 17.26 from its previous close. Elevated oil prices are worsening losses for emerging Asian currencies as nations like the Philippines experience soaring import costs. The Philippine peso has slid more than eight percent this year, making it the biggest loser in Asia.

These favorable exchange rates are causing households to reassess their financial strategies. Expats are currently weighing whether to lock in the present market levels or wait for further shifts in currency valuations. The sustained weakness in these home currencies provides a direct financial advantage for workers transferring funds from the UAE.

stories.title: Adrian Hamilton-Manns Officially Takes Over as New CEO of PIA
stories.summary:
Adrian Hamilton-Manns has formally taken charge as the chief executive officer of Pakistan International Airlines, bringing over three decades of professional aviation background to the national carrier. The airline announced the transition on X on Monday, emphasizing that his extensive leadership history represents an important milestone in the organisation's ongoing transformation.

Hamilton-Manns possesses experience leading three different airlines as CEO and holds a strong reputation for restructuring and reviving aviation enterprises. His arrival succeeds the tenure of outgoing CEO Air Vice Marshal Amir Hayat, whose service during a period of intense operational and regulatory hurdles was praised by the airline's board and consortium.

During Hayat's time in office, PIA navigated complex difficulties, improved aviation safety measures, successfully lifted bans on European and British flight routes, and prepared the entity for privatization. The airline credited his leadership with helping restore vital international connections and solidifying the institution's standing.

The leadership shift occurs following the government's major privatization initiative last December, when a 75% stake in PIA was sold for Rs10.1 billion in cash. A prominent business consortium later placed the winning bid of Rs135 billion in an open auction, with the Arif Habib Consortium officially assuming management control of the airline in June.

stories.title: Kuwaiti Authorities Arrest Reckless Driver and Crush His Modified Car
stories.summary:
Kuwaiti law enforcement officials in Kuwait City detained a motorist following the widespread circulation of a social media video that captured him executing dangerous driving maneuvers. Officers from the Ahmadi Governorate Security Directorate tracked and located the targeted automobile within the Ali Sabah Al-Salem neighborhood, utilizing surveillance conducted by the Vehicle Operations Section of the Operations and Patrols Department.

Following its initial confiscation, the automobile was transported to the Ali Sabah Al-Salem Police Station, where formal charges were filed against the owner for putting the safety of fellow citizens at risk. The General Traffic Department's Security Control Department subsequently tracked down the operator, initiated legal proceedings against him, and moved him to the Central Prison. Authorities ultimately delivered the seized car to the crusher.

The Ministry of Interior issued a strong statement following the incident, pledging to maintain rigorous oversight over dangerous traffic infractions. Officials emphasized that severe legal consequences await any individual whose conduct threatens the well-being of people sharing the roadways.

This enforcement action underscores the growing reliance on digital surveillance and social media monitoring by regional authorities to identify and penalize aggressive motorists. By destroying the modified vehicle alongside prosecuting the operator, the ministry aims to deter similar hazardous behavior across the nation.

stories.title: امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ کا وسط مدتی انتخابات میں مسٹر ویٹو بننے کا اعلان
stories.summary: امریکی صدر ڈونلڈ ٹرمپ نے نیویارک پوسٹ کو دیے گئے ایک انٹرویو میں خبردار کیا ہے کہ اگر آنے والے وسط مدتی انتخابات میں ری پبلکن پارٹی کو شکست ہوئی اور مخالف جماعت ڈیموکریٹس نے کانگریس کے ایوانوں میں اکثریت حاصل کرلی، تو وہ خود کو مسٹر ویٹو بنادیں گے۔ ان کا کہنا تھا کہ اس صورت میں وہ ڈیموکریٹس کے پیش کردہ تمام بلز کو مکمل طور پر مسترد کر دیں گے تاکہ ان کے ایجنڈے کو آگے بڑھنے سے روکا جا سکے۔ صدر کا ماننا ہے کہ مسلسل ویٹو کیے جانے کی وجہ سے مخالف جماعت کا وقت ضائع ہوگا اور آخرکار وہ ایک یا دو ماہ بعد مسائل کے حل اور معاملات طے کرنے کے لیے خود مذاکرات کی میز پر آنے پر مجبور ہوجائیں گے۔ امریکی آئین کے قوانین کے مطابق، ملک کا صدر کانگریس کی طرف سے منظور کردہ کسی بھی قانون کو ویٹو کرنے کا اختیار رکھتا ہے، تاہم دونوں ایوانوں میں دو تہائی ارکان کی بھاری حمایت حاصل ہونے پر صدارتی ویٹو کو منسوخ بھی کیا جا سکتا ہے۔ ماضی میں بھی قانون سازی کے عمل میں دونوں اہم جماعتوں کے درمیان روایتی طور پر سمجھوتے طے پاتے رہے ہیں۔ موجودہ صدر نے اس امید کا اظہار کیا ہے کہ ان کی اپنی جماعت ری پبلکن اس انتخابی معرکے میں فتح یاب ہوگی تاکہ انہیں اس دفاعی حکمت عملی کا سہارا لینے کی ضرورت ہی پیش نہ آئے۔ وہ اپنی صدارت کی دوسری مدت کے دوران اب تک دو بار اور پہلی مدت کے دوران کل دس مرتبہ اپنے اس صدارتی ویٹو کے اختیار کو استعمال کر چکے ہیں۔ امریکا بھر میں یہ اہم وسط مدتی انتخابات آئندہ تین نومبر کو منعقد ہونے جا رہے ہیں، جن میں ایوان نمائندگان کی تمام چار سو پینتیس اور سینیٹ کی کل ایک سو میں سے چونتیس نشستوں کے لیے پولنگ ہوگی۔ ان انتخابات میں ڈیموکریٹس کے لیے ایوان نمائندگان میں اکثریت حاصل کرنے کی خاطر محض تین مزید نشستیں جیتنا لازمی قرار دیا گیا ہے۔ اس پورے عمل کا مقصد یہ یقینی بنانا ہے کہ حکومتی ایجنڈے پر عمل درآمد میں طاقت کا توازن برقرار رہے اور سیاسی محاذ آرائی کے دوران قانونی فیصلوں میں توازن کی راہ نکالی جاسکے۔

stories.title: Ukrainian Air Raid App Hacked to Display False Nuclear Alerts
stories.summary:
Ukrainian military officials reported that the nation's official public air raid notification application experienced a cyberattack. For a brief duration, the platform displayed erroneous warnings indicating that Kyiv and other regions faced imminent nuclear and chemical dangers, alongside warnings regarding potential street battles and the alleged deployment of Russia’s hypersonic Oreshnik missile.

The Ukrainian Air Force released a statement via Telegram confirming the unauthorized digital interference, urging citizens to remain composed and reassuring the public that no actual radiation hazard existed. Meanwhile, the Ministry for Digital Transformation stated that the affected software was taken offline, though alternative warning systems and traditional air raid sirens continued to operate normally.

In a parallel digital security event occurring around the same time, the mobile application belonging to the Russian emergencies ministry suffered a severe cyber assault. According to the state news agency TASS, that breach similarly distributed incorrect notifications to the local population early Monday morning.

At the time of the reports, officials had not determined whether the cyber operations targeting the Ukrainian and Russian warning applications were connected. Both incidents highlighted the ongoing vulnerability of critical public infrastructure and emergency communication networks to hostile digital interference amid ongoing conflicts.

stories.title: ثانیہ مرزا اور شعیب ملک کی بیٹے کی آٹھویں سالگرہ پر نیک تمناؤں کا اظہار
stories.summary: سابق بھارتی ٹینس سٹار ثانیہ مرزا اور پاکستان کرکٹ ٹیم کے سابق کپتان شعیب ملک نے اپنے صاحبزادے اذہان مرزا ملک کی آٹھویں سالگرہ کے پرمسرت موقع پر سوشل میڈیا اکاؤنٹس کے ذریعے اپنے بیٹے کے لیے محبت بھرے پیغامات شیئر کیے ہیں۔ ثانیہ مرزا نے اس خاص دن کی مناسبت سے تصاویر جاری کرتے ہوئے اپنے بیٹے کے ساتھ ہونے پر گہری خوشی کا اظہار کیا۔ دوسری جانب، شعیب ملک نے بھی دو روز بعد ایک مختصر مگر محبت بھرا پیغام جاری کرتے ہوئے بیٹے کو سالگرہ کی مبارکباد دی اور لکھا کہ تم سے محبت ہے۔ ان دونوں کی شادی سن 2010 میں انجام پائی تھی اور اکتوبر 2018 میں ان کے ہاں اس بیٹے کی پیدائش ہوئی تھی۔ تاہم دونوں نے باضابطہ طور پر سال 2024 میں اپنی علیحدگی کا اعلان کردیا تھا، اور اسی سال جنوری میں شعیب ملک نے پاکستانی اداکارہ ثنا جاوید سے دوسری شادی کرلی تھی۔ باہمی علیحدگی کے بعد بھی یہ دونوں والدین اپنے بیٹے کی زندگی کے تمام اہم مواقع پر سوشل میڈیا کے ذریعے خوشگوار لمحات عوام کے ساتھ سانجھا کرتے رہتے ہیں۔ پیشہ ورانہ پس منظر کے لحاظ سے، ثانیہ مرزا نے سال 2023 میں پروفیشنل ٹینس کے کھیل کو خیرباد کہہ دیا تھا، جو اپنے کیریئر میں چھ گرینڈ سلم ٹائٹلز جیتنے کے ساتھ ساتھ سن 2015 میں خواتین کی ڈبلز عالمی رینکنگ میں پہلے نمبر پر بھی قابض رہی تھیں۔ جبکہ شعیب ملک نے دو دہائیوں سے زائد عرصے پر محیط اپنے طویل کرکٹ کیریئر میں پاکستان کی طرف سے پینتیس ٹیسٹ، دو سو ستاسی ون ڈے اور ایک سو چوبیس ٹی ٹوئنٹی بین الاقوامی میچز کھیل کر ملک کا نام روشن کیا۔ اس جوڑے کی علیحدگی کے باوجود بیٹے کی سالگرہ پر ان کی طرف سے پیغامات کا اشتراک مداحوں کی توجہ کا مرکز بنا رہا۔

stories.title: Sindh Chief Minister Inaugurates Rs250 Million Food Walk in Karachi
stories.summary:
Sindh Chief Minister Syed Murad Ali Shah inaugurated the Sindhi Muslim Food Walk in Chanesar Town on Sunday. The Rs250 million urban improvement project was completed through the town administration's own resources, which the chief minister praised as an example of effective financial management and planning by local government institutions. Executed by TMC Chanesar Town, the project began on February 1, 2026, and finished in October 2026. It features overhauled sewerage lines, underground electrical cabling, removed overhead wires, repaired roads and footpaths, new streetlights, decorative lighting, landscaping, updated parking, and fresh traffic signs.

During the inauguration ceremony, the chief minister urged other town administrations to replicate the project by boosting their own revenue generation and efficiently using financial resources. He noted that Karachi holds immense potential for cultural and food tourism, and such initiatives help generate economic activity, attract private investment, and create jobs. He directed the local administration to maintain proper standards for cleanliness, waste management, plantation, and traffic control. Furthermore, he highlighted broader provincial development efforts, noting that the government has doubled OZT grants for Town Municipal Corporations and Union Committees and devolved the Urban Immovable Property Tax to support local bodies.

Addressing wider municipal and security concerns, Mr Shah mentioned that work on 165 roads across Karachi will soon commence alongside major infrastructure initiatives like the Shahrah-i-Bhutto Expressway, K-IV Water Supply Project, and various BRT lines. He also discussed the ongoing rehabilitation of public spaces, parks, and upcoming food streets on Tipu Sultan Road and Burns Road. In a lighthearted remark, he poked fun at media coverage surrounding electricity poles, noting that attention toward obstructing poles has helped resolve public difficulties. He additionally directed the Inspector General of Police Sindh to ensure strong security at the food walk and emphasized that public weapon displays should be avoided to prevent citizen fear.

In a separate meeting in Karachi, Chief Minister Shah and World Bank Country Director Bolormaa Amgaabazar reviewed progress on $3.85 billion worth of development projects funded by the bank across the province. Both officials reaffirmed their dedication to finishing these schemes on time. The ongoing collaboration reflects the provincial government's broader agenda to modernize infrastructure, strengthen local governance, and stimulate economic growth throughout Sindh with international backing.

stories.title: Michigan Democrat Haley Stevens Endorses Republican Mike Rogers in Tight US Senate Race
stories.summary:
US Representative Haley Stevens, a Michigan Democrat, publicly endorsed Republican Mike Rogers on Sunday, providing an unexpected boost to the Republican Party ahead of midterm elections that will determine control of Congress. Stevens, who lost the Democratic Senate primary to Abdul El-Sayed in a competitive race, appeared with Rogers at a Detroit church. The endorsement threatens to deepen divisions within the Democratic Party in a battleground state essential for Democratic hopes of reclaiming the US Senate. Stevens stated she did not belong in El-Sayed's campaign, while President Donald Trump later invited her to join the Republican Party during an Iowa rally.

The unexpected move followed the unraveling of a planned joint appearance between Stevens and El-Sayed. The event fell apart after Stevens called on El-Sayed to condemn an outside group's ad that she argued blamed Israel for high grocery prices, describing the ad as painful. El-Sayed's campaign had previously asked Stevens to skip his events to avoid distractions. Following the endorsement, Republicans praised Stevens for political courage, while Trump repeated unproven claims regarding the Democratic nominee. Conversely, El-Sayed's campaign experienced a surge in fundraising, collecting $1.2 million in the four hours following the announcement. Polls indicated El-Sayed maintained a lead over Rogers, though the endorsement resulted in several of Stevens' congressional staff resigning and drew criticism from local voters.

Concurrently, the midterm elections involve contests for all 435 House seats and 35 Senate seats, with narrow Republican majorities currently holding both chambers. Democrats are favored to win the House while engaging in a tight contest for the Senate, where outcomes in states like Michigan and Alaska remain pivotal. In Alaska, a federal judge dismissed a Justice Department lawsuit that sought to block the certification of results if Republican incumbent Senator Dan S. Sullivan narrowly loses. The lawsuit stemmed from controversy over a challenger named Daniel J. Sullivan Jr appearing on the ballot, whom the incumbent's camp alleged was recruited as a spoiler by the campaign of Democrat Mary Peltola. Peltola and Sullivan Jr have both denied coordination, and the incumbent senator stated he would accept the final election results.

stories.title: Oil Refineries Absorb Rs15 Billion Burden to Lower Petrol Prices
stories.summary:
The federal government announced that domestic oil refineries will absorb a monthly financial burden of Rs15 billion to shield consumers from surging global fuel costs amid the US-Israeli conflict involving Iran. Federal Petroleum Minister Ali Pervaiz Malik and Information Minister Attaullah Tarar revealed the measure during a joint press conference in Islamabad on Monday.

Malik explained that the arrangement prevented a scheduled Rs15 increase in petrol prices, allowing the commodity to remain cheaper than current international rates. Refineries agreed to ramp up throughput and forego immediate gains, with Malik noting that their recent three-month profits exceeded last year's total annual earnings. The government also revised pricing mechanisms to utilize historical pre-war margins for calculating ex-refinery costs.

During the briefing, officials addressed broader regional disruptions affecting energy logistics and procurement. Malik disclosed that a Pakistan-bound liquefied natural gas (LNG) carrier, identified as the Al Mayeda, was attacked prior to entering the Strait of Hormuz. Qatar and Saudi Arabia strongly condemned the incident as a threat to global energy security, while Qatari authorities launched investigations.

Tarar confirmed that the Prime Minister's Fuel Relief Scheme for motorcyclists and car owners will proceed, with Rs27 billion already distributed among 15 million registered beneficiaries. Officials urged the public to avoid speculation surrounding the vessel attack while monitoring supply stability.

stories.title: مظفر گڑھ میں چار سال سے بند واحد سرکاری اسکول دوبارہ کھل گیا
stories.summary:
پنجاب کے ضلع مظفر گڑھ کے علاقے بستی ساون والا میں چار سال سے بند رہنے والا واحد سرکاری اسکول محکمۂ تعلیم کے احکامات پر کھول دیا گیا ہے۔ صوبائی محکمۂ تعلیم کے مطابق یہ اسکول اساتذہ کی عارضی ایڈجسمنٹ کے ذریعے فعال کیا گیا ہے تاکہ مقامی بچوں کی تعلیم کا سلسلہ شروع ہو سکے۔

اسکول کے کھلنے کے بعد علاقے کے ابتدائی طور پر 19 بچوں نے اس میں داخلہ لے لیا ہے جو کہ اس پسماندہ علاقے کے تعلیمی مستقبل کے لیے ایک اہم قدم ہے۔ تاہم اہلِ علاقہ نے بنیادی سہولیات کی عدم دستیابی پر تشویش کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے بتایا ہے کہ اسکول کی عمارت میں اب تک بجلی، پینے کا صاف پانی اور فرنیچر میسر نہیں ہے۔

اس اقدام سے مقامی والدین میں خوشی کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے کیونکہ طویل عرصے سے اسکول بند ہونے کی وجہ سے بچوں کو دور دراز علاقوں کا رخ کرنا پڑتا تھا یا ان کی تعلیم رکی ہوئی تھی۔ اب جب کہ اسکول کھول دیا گیا ہے، مقامی افراد نے حکومت سے مطالبہ کیا ہے کہ وہ فوری طور پر وہاں بجلی، پانی اور بیٹھنے کا سامان فراہم کرے تاکہ بچوں کو مشکلات کا سامنا نہ کرناپڑے۔

محکمۂ تعلیم کے اس عارضی اقدام کو عوامی سطح پر سراہا گیا ہے لیکن اسکول کی حالت بہتر بنانے کے لیے مزید حکومتی اقدامات کی ضرورت ہے۔ اسکول کے فعال ہونے سے بستی ساون والا کے بچوں کو ان کی دہلیز پر تعلیم کی سہولت ملنا شروع ہو گئی ہے جو کہ علاقے کی ترقی کے لیے انتہائی اہم ہے۔

stories.title: Pakistani Minister Salik Hussain Criticizes Punjab Governance and Fund Allocation
stories.summary:
Federal Minister for Overseas Pakistanis Chaudhry Salik Hussain has publicly criticized governance, administrative inefficiencies, and the distribution of development funds in Punjab. In an interview, Hussain endorsed similar remarks made by Qaiser Ahmed Sheikh and claimed that systemic problems are slowing down provincial progress. He alleged that political preferences heavily influence development decisions, noting that a major portion of the provincial budget goes to Lahore while districts lacking government-backed winners risk missing out on projects.

Hussain also addressed alleged corruption in Punjab, stating that while he lacked direct documentary evidence, rumors and corruption-related files were widespread enough to fill cupboards. Furthermore, the federal minister criticized public spending on official aircraft, arguing that leaders must show greater sensitivity to economic conditions and provide clear justifications for the outcomes of official trips. He claimed that the government system faces unnecessary internal hurdles and called for greater empowerment and accountability for ministers.

Reflecting on political leadership in Punjab, Hussain praised former chief minister Chaudhry Pervez Elahi as the best he had seen in his lifetime. He credited Elahi with carrying out significant development work across the province without any political or personal discrimination. Hussain's remarks highlight ongoing political and administrative tensions regarding resource distribution and regional development priorities in Pakistan's most populous province.

The matters raised by the federal minister touch on core issues of governance and resource transparency that directly impact local populations. Matters of budget allocation, administrative hurdles, and political favoritism remain central to discussions surrounding regional development and political accountability in the country. Hussain's commentary underscores the broader challenges faced by ministers whose official authority is restricted while trying to deliver results.

stories.title: Inter Miami Ascends to Second Place After Late Comeback Win Over New England
stories.summary:
Lionel Messi scored a crucial late goal to propel Inter Miami to a 2-1 comeback victory over the New England Revolution, lifting his side into second place in the MLS Eastern Conference. Messi dribbled past three defenders before finishing past US national team goalkeeper Matt Turner in the 83rd minute, securing three points just before a late New England equalizer was disallowed for a marginal offside review.

The match remained goalless through the first half before New England broke the deadlock early in the second period. Peyton Miller cut back a pass for Ilay Feingold, who backheeled it to Daniel Gazdag to smash home. Miami equalized in the 69th minute when Telasco Segovia crossed into the box and Messi directed the ball off the back of his head to German Berterame for the finish, setting up Messi's late game-winner.

With this victory, Miami sits one point ahead of the New England Revolution with only one regular-season match remaining. A subsequent win against Charlotte on Saturday will guarantee home advantage until the Conference Finals and also secured Miami a spot in next year's CONCACAF Champions Cup. Meanwhile, the Columbus Crew and Orlando City also clinched playoff berths following the New York Red Bulls' defeat.

In other league action, Nashville extended an impressive run to tie the MLS record for most points in a single season with 74, lifting the Supporters' Shield at Geodis Park. Nashville completed an undefeated home campaign with 15 wins, showcasing a dominant home-field advantage that top seeds retain throughout the postseason leading up to the MLS Cup on December 18.

stories.title: Saad Baig Aims for Higher Scores After Promising ODI Debut
stories.summary:
Pakistan’s emerging wicketkeeper-batter Saad Baig has expressed his ambition to convert promising starts into substantial innings following his encouraging entry into international cricket. The 20-year-old accumulated 185 runs across five matches during the recent tri-nation One Day International series, which concluded with Pakistan defeating Sri Lanka by three wickets in the final at Gaddafi Stadium in Lahore.

Baig delivered a crucial knock of 74 runs in the title match to help successfully chase down a 326-run target, while also securing three catches behind the stumps. Reviewing his maiden series on a Pakistan Cricket Board digital programme, Baig emphasized his strategy to transition the confidence gained in domestic competitions directly to the international stage by trusting his natural abilities.

Reflecting on his development, the left-handed batsman highlighted the value of adapting his approach to match conditions and building partnerships. He progressed through Pakistan's youth ranks across under-13, under-16, and under-19 levels, eventually captaining the squad at the 2024 ICC Men’s Under-19 World Cup where the team reached the semi-finals.

Transitioning from age-group cricket to the senior national setup has been rewarding for Baig, especially alongside peers from his junior cohort. Looking ahead, he intends to focus on continuous learning, addressing areas of weakness, and delivering consistent performances for the national team.

stories.title: قطر نے پاکستانی شہریوں کے لیے ویزا آن ارائیول کی سہولت بحال کر دی
stories.summary:
قطر نے پاکستانی، انڈین اور تھائی شہریوں کے لیے 30 روز تک کے لیے مفت ویزا آن ارائیول کی سہولت دوبارہ بحال کر دی ہے۔ اس حوالے سے قطر کی وزارت داخلہ کے ماتحت پاسپورٹس اور سرحدی امور سے متعلق محکمے کی ویب سائٹ پر باضابطہ شرائط شائع کر دی گئی ہیں۔ یہ سہولت مخصوص شرائط کے ساتھ دی جا رہی ہے۔

اہلیت کے لیے مسافر کے پاس کم از کم تین ماہ تک کارآمد پاسپورٹ، آمد و رفت کا تصدیق شدہ فضائی ٹکٹ، ڈسکور قطر پلیٹ فارم کے ذریعے ہوٹل کی بکنگ اور منظور شدہ ادارے کی ہیلتھ انشورنس ہونا لازمی ہے۔ پاکستان کی وزارت خارجہ کی ہدایات کے مطابق مسافروں کو قطر روانگی سے قبل چند اضافی تقاضے بھی پورے کرنا ہوں گے۔

وزارت خارجہ کے مطابق انشورنس کے لیے کم از کم ایک ماہ کا سرٹیفکیٹ درکار ہے جس کی قیمت 50 قطری ریال یعنی تقریباً 3800 پاکستانی روپے بتائی گئی ہے۔ انشورنس کے لیے قطر انشورنس کمپنی (کیو آئی سی) اور لائف اینڈ میڈیکل انشورنس کمپنی (کیو ایل ایم) کو ترجیح دینے کا کہا گیا ہے جبکہ انشورنس مکمل ہونے پر ای میل موصول ہوتی ہے۔

دوحہ پہنچنے پر مسافروں کو امیگریشن سے پہلے حمد انٹرنیشنل ایئرپورٹ پر موجود ڈسکور قطر ڈیسک سے رجوع کر کے کاغذات کی تصدیق کرانا ہوگی۔ اس کے بعد امیگریشن کاؤنٹرز پر ویزا کارروائی، آنکھوں کی سکیننگ اور بائیومیٹرک کے مراحل مکمل کیے جائیں گے۔ رواں برس مارچ میں یہ سہولت عارضی طور پر معطل کی گئی تھی لیکن اب اسے بحال کر دیا گیا ہے۔

stories.title: Investigation Record in Mir Raza Ali Case Transferred to Joint Investigation Team
stories.summary:
The investigation into the death of 25-year-old businessman and Institute of Business Administration graduate Mir Raza Ali has been formally transferred to a Joint Investigation Team (JIT). Headed by Deputy Inspector General Irfan Baloch, the JIT will oversee further proceedings and examine all evidence related to the case. Mir Raza Ali had gone missing on July 28 after leaving his home in PECHS, and his body bearing gunshot wounds was discovered a day later in bushes located in Gulistan-e-Jauhar.

Deputy Superintendent of Police Siraj Lashari confirmed that all relevant documents and records had been handed over to the joint investigation body. A representative of the JIT is scheduled to appear before the court to provide a progress report on the ongoing investigation. The transition marks a new phase in the inquiry as authorities attempt to uncover the full circumstances surrounding the entrepreneur's death.

The formation of the JIT follows adjustments requested by the victim's father, Mir Hussain. After expressing gratitude to the Sindh government for establishing the team, Mir Hussain requested the replacement of the initial National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency representative, Arslan Manzoor. Although acknowledging the officer's competence, the father noted that the official had previously focused on a suicide narrative during two months of work and advocated for an officer with a fresh perspective.

The National Cyber Crime Investigation Agency subsequently nominated Deputy Director Shehzad Akbar to represent the agency on the panel. The updated JIT is now tasked with reviewing the comprehensive case file and pursuing all leads regarding the young businessman's death. The family and public continue to follow the investigation closely as judicial and law enforcement bodies advance their inquiries.

stories.title: Saudi Civil Defence Issues All-Clear After Intercepting Houthi Ballistic Missile Attack
stories.summary:
Saudi Arabia’s civil defence authority announced that a security threat had passed shortly after issuing alerts for several southern and western cities, including Khamis Mushait, Abha, Taif, and Najran. The precautionary warnings coincided with weeks of escalating hostilities between the kingdom and Yemen’s Houthi movement. The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen stated that it successfully intercepted and destroyed a ballistic missile launched by the Houthis toward the southern region of the kingdom.

The southern regions of Saudi Arabia, which share a border with Yemen, have frequently been targeted by Houthi drone and missile strikes. These attacks have historically focused on military installations and critical energy infrastructure, including sites in Jazan. The continued cross-border hostilities pose significant risks to Saudi Arabia's domestic energy production, oil refineries, and vital export supply chains situated near the Red Sea coast.

In response to the persistent airborne threats, the Saudi-led coalition has carried out retaliatory airstrikes against Houthi positions inside Yemen. The renewed violence highlights ongoing vulnerabilities surrounding regional energy facilities, including the East-West pipeline and oil export terminals in Yanbu. These continuous escalations underscore the persistent security challenges facing Saudi infrastructure amid the prolonged conflict in Yemen.

stories.title: Warriors Secure Third Consecutive Victory Against Champions in Faisalabad
stories.summary:
The Warriors cricket team secured a comfortable 24-run win over the Champions in the fifth match of the PCB Women’s Super-3 T20 Tournament at Iqbal Stadium in Faisalabad on Monday. Muneeba Ali's Warriors defended a total of 154-8, bowling out Tuba Hassan's Champions side for 130 in 19.2 overs to claim their third consecutive win of the tournament.

Batting first after losing the toss, the Warriors recovered from a shaky start at 66-4 thanks to a 65-run partnership between Hafsa Khalid, who scored 47 runs from 36 balls, and Rameen Shamim, who added 29 runs. Diana Baig contributed a quick 19 runs off 14 balls to help set a 155-run target. Tayyaba Imdad picked up two wickets for the Champions.

In response, the Champions fell short despite resistance from Natalia Parvaiz with 31 runs and Shawaal Zulfiqar with 22 runs. Left-arm spinner Ayesha Bilal dismantled the batting lineup by taking four wickets for 15 runs, earning the player of the match award. Diana Baig and Zunash Abdul Sattar each claimed two wickets to seal the victory.

With this win, the Warriors maintain their unbeaten streak and prepare to face the Incredibles in their next match on Tuesday. Meanwhile, the Champions have secured a berth in the final after winning two of their four matches, while the Incredibles have been eliminated from the race after losing all three of their outings.

stories.title: Australia Unveils New-Look White-Ball Squads for Upcoming England Series
stories.summary:
Australia has selected a fresh mix of players for upcoming white-ball matches against England, featuring several emerging talents and uncapped names alongside experienced figures. Mitchell Marsh has been named as the captain for both the one-day international and Twenty20 squads.

Chairman of selectors George Bailey noted that these fixtures offer a strong platform for players to prove themselves against formidable opponents. The selections feature young fast bowler Mahli Beardman, allrounders Jack Edwards and Liam Scott, as well as batting prospects Ollie Peake and Jake Fraser-McGurk. Wicketkeepers Lachlan Shaw and Sam Harper also earned spots, with Harper and Shaw being the two uncapped players in the group.

Australia is set to play three home ODIs against England from November 13 to 18, followed by five T20 matches. These games serve as vital preparation for the next generation ahead of the 2027 World Cup, which will be held in South Africa, Zimbabwe, and Namibia. Meanwhile, senior fast bowlers Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, and Josh Hazlewood are being rested following a demanding Test series in South Africa.

Following the white-ball series, Australia faces a busy schedule that includes a home Test series against New Zealand, an upcoming tour of India, and an Ashes campaign. Selectors are carefully monitoring player workloads to balance physical and mental preparation amidst the demanding international calendar.

stories.title: Israeli Strikes Leave Three Dead in Gaza Amid Stalled Ceasefire Talks
stories.summary:
Israeli airstrikes resulted in the deaths of at least three Palestinians and left several others wounded across the Gaza Strip. Health officials in the territory confirmed the casualties following the latest escalation in violence.

Medics reported that two individuals were killed and six others injured in two distinct airstrikes targeting Khan Younis in the southern part of the enclave. A third fatality was recorded due to an Israeli airstrike in the town of Al-Mussadar. The Israeli military did not immediately issue a comment regarding these specific military operations.

The recent intensification of strikes comes as Israel accuses the Hamas militant group of rearming and initiating attacks in violation of a year-old ceasefire agreement. Hamas has strongly denied these allegations, countering that Israel is attempting to undermine the existing peace deal and obstructing reconstruction efforts in the territory.

Negotiations have stalled as parties fail to agree on terms regarding the disarmament of Hamas or the withdrawal of Israeli troops. Israeli forces currently control approximately two-thirds of Gaza, leaving more than two million residents largely confined to the remaining third amidst extensive war ruins and makeshift shelters. Local health authorities report that at least 1,580 Palestinians have died in attacks since the ceasefire began, adding to a death toll exceeding 74,000 since the broader conflict erupted on October 7, 2023.

stories.title: نظامِ شمسی میں نیا ممکنہ بونا سیارہ دریافت کر لیا گیا
stories.summary:
ماہرینِ فلکیات نے نظامِ شمسی میں ایک انتہائی بڑا ممکنہ بونا سیارہ دریافت کیا ہے جس نے سائنسدانوں کو حیرت میں مبتلا کر دیا ہے۔ اس پراسرار خلائی جسم کا قطر تین سو ستر سے نو سو تیس میل کے درمیان بتایا گیا ہے، جو اسے نظامِ شمسی کے سب سے بڑے بونے سیاروں کی فہرست میں شامل کر سکتا ہے۔ عارضی طور پر اس دریافت کو دو ہزار چھبیس ای ڈی ایک سو تراسی کا نام دیا گیا ہے، اور باضابطہ تصدیق کے بعد اسے یونانی نام دیا جا سکتا ہے۔

یہ اہم دریافت چلی کے آٹھ ہزار آٹھ سو فٹ بلند پہاڑ کی چوٹی پر نصب طاقتور ویرا سی روبن دوربین کے ذریعے عمل میں آئی۔ ماہرِ فلکیات میتھیو ہولمین نے دو ہزار چھبیس کے دوران اس دوربین سے ملنے والے ڈیٹا کا جائزہ لینے کے لیے ایک جدید کمپیوٹر پروگرام کا استعمال کیا۔ یہ سسٹم اربوں متحرک خلائی اجسام کی جانچ کر رہا تھا جب اس کی نظر اس نئے ممکنہ بونے سیارے پر پڑی۔

اگر اس کا قطر زیادہ سے زیادہ یعنی نو سو تیس میل تک نکلا تو یہ برطانیہ کی لمبائی سے بھی زیادہ چوڑا ثابت ہوگا۔ اس سے قبل اس محدود اور مخصوص گروپ میں سیرس، پلوٹو، ہاؤمیا، میک میک اور ایریس جیسے بونے سیارے شامل ہیں۔ اس دریافت کے بعد نظامِ شمسی کے پوشیدہ رازوں کو سمجھنے میں مزید مدد ملنے کی توقع کی جارہی ہے۔

stories.title: Coach Andrew McDonald Defends Australia Despite Series Defeat in South Africa
stories.summary:
Australia cricket coach Andrew McDonald has defended his squad despite a 2-1 series loss to South Africa, which triggered significant public criticism and calls for sweeping changes. Conceding that the team underperformed during the tour, McDonald emphasized that the lineup still contains high-caliber players.

The disappointment culminated in the final day of the third test at Newlands, where Australia was bowled out for 111 while chasing a target of 288. The defeat marked the team's third loss in five tests, costing them their top world ranking and complicating their path to the World Test Championship final. Critics have raised concerns over an aging test squad and a perceived reluctance to transition younger players into the side.

McDonald addressed individual performances, noting that Marnus Labuschagne struggled on the tour with 131 runs at an average of 21.83, though he stopped short of closing the door on the batsman's future. Veteran Steve Smith missed the final test due to a neck issue but is expected to be fit for the upcoming home series against New Zealand. Despite the struggles of spinner Nathan Lyon, McDonald pointed to positives such as Cameron Green's successful return from injury and Josh Inglis scoring a century.

Looking ahead, Australia prepares for a four-test home series against New Zealand in December and January, followed by a five-match series in India. McDonald stressed the importance of careful evaluation through domestic Sheffield Shield cricket rather than making hasty decisions in the immediate aftermath of the tour.

stories.title: Doctors Across Pakistan Launch Two-Day Boycott Over FIRs and FBR Policies
stories.summary:
Medical professionals across Pakistan have initiated a two-day protest by suspending outpatient department services at public and private hospitals, as well as private clinics. The nationwide action was organized by the Pakistan Medical Association to oppose government policies and legal challenges facing healthcare workers.

The decision to halt routine services stems from a unanimous resolution adopted by doctors nationwide and directives from central leadership. While outpatient services and private clinics remain closed in cities like Karachi, hospital emergency departments continue to operate normally to ensure urgent patient care is not disrupted.

The protest highlights four primary grievances affecting the medical community: the filing of allegedly unjustified first information reports against doctors, related legal proceedings, instances of alleged humiliation and harassment, and the Federal Board of Revenue's compulsory implementation of the Point of Sale system.

PMA Karachi leaders emphasized the vital need to protect the professional independence and dignity of medical practitioners. The association has urged healthcare institutions and professionals to support the shutdown while assuring the public that emergency medical facilities remain fully functional to handle immediate needs.

stories.title: Kimi Antonelli Makes History as Formula One's Youngest Champion
stories.summary:
Twenty-year-old Kimi Antonelli secured the Formula One world championship in Mexico on Sunday, finishing third behind Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton. By clinching the title with four races remaining in the season, the young Italian broke Sebastian Vettel's long-standing record to become the youngest champion in F1 history at 20 years and 68 days old. He is also the first Italian to win the championship in 73 years, following Alberto Ascari.

Flung into Formula One in 2025 at just 18 years old, Antonelli enjoyed a stellar second season with Mercedes, comfortably outperforming his British teammate George Russell. After finishing second in the Australian season opener, Antonelli dominated by winning the next five races and arriving in Mexico with nine victories out of 18 events. His campaign featured standout moments, including a remarkable drive in Monza where he started 19th and worked his way through the field to win his home grand prix.

Born to mother Elisabetta and father Marco, a former driver and team principal, Antonelli began karting at age seven despite his father's initial hesitation regarding the financial and physical cruelties of motorsport. Discovered at age 11 by Gwen Lagrue, head of the Mercedes junior driver programme, Antonelli rose rapidly through karting, Italian and German F4, and Formula Regional before leaping straight to F2 and subsequently into F1 following Lewis Hamilton's departure to Ferrari. Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff praised the rookie's ability to handle intense pressure, media scrutiny, and high expectations.

Off the track, Antonelli has charmed the F1 paddock with his cheerful personality, humor, and lighthearted pranks directed at his race engineer, Peter Bonnington. With his combination of raw speed, mental resilience, and technical skill, the young Italian has established himself as a dominant force in the sport, earning praise from mentors and rivals alike as he secures his place at the pinnacle of motorsport.

stories.title: Pakistan Health Ministry and Sehat Kahani Launch Phase Two Telemedicine
stories.summary:
The Ministry of Health and digital healthcare platform Sehat Kahani signed a Memorandum of Understanding in Islamabad on Monday to advance telemedicine cooperation. Federal Minister for Health Syed Mustafa Kamal and representatives from Sehat Kahani participated in the signing ceremony.

Speaking at the event, Syed Mustafa Kamal stated that the government has successfully concluded the initial phase of its telemedicine initiative and is now advancing to the second phase. During the first phase, the collaboration resulted in the creation of 10 telemedicine centers, and the latest agreement will introduce an additional 10 centers.

Furthermore, the federal minister announced that the Outdoor Patient Department and the Trauma Center at the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences are being integrated into the expanding telemedicine network. These measures are designed to enhance accessibility and healthcare quality for the general public.

The initiative is part of ongoing efforts by leadership, including the former Karachi mayor and Muttahida Qaumi Movement-Pakistan leader, to implement practical health sector improvements and elevate living standards for common citizens across the country through digital health integration.

stories.title: Candice Swanepoel and Tom Brady Spark Engagement Rumours in Florida
stories.summary:
Supermodel Candice Swanepoel and retired NFL star Tom Brady have sparked widespread engagement speculation after the model was spotted wearing a gold band on her left ring finger. The 37-year-old Victoria’s Secret Angel was seen wearing the jewellery with an all-black outfit in Surfside, Florida, in late October 2026.

Despite the buzz surrounding the sighting, there is no official confirmation of an engagement, and neither Brady nor Swanepoel has publicly addressed the relationship rumours. Reports suggest the ring may simply be a personal fashion choice rather than a proposal token. Dating speculation involving the pair first surfaced via Us Weekly and People, with TMZ sources reporting that their relationship began in June with private meetings around Miami.

Swanepoel, a South African supermodel famous for her work with Victoria’s Secret, also established the sustainable swimwear brand Tropic of C in 2018. She shares two sons, Anacan and Ariel, with her former fiancé Hermann Nicoli, whom she split from in 2018 after more than ten years together. In addition to the relationship buzz, Page Six reported alleged tension between Swanepoel and fellow model Joan Smalls, who was previously linked to Brady, though Swanepoel's representative emphasized a longstanding friendship and mutual respect between the two models.

The unconfirmed engagement rumours continue to draw public attention as both stars maintain privacy regarding their personal lives. The mysterious gold ring remains the sole focal point of the current speculation as neither party provides clarity on their relationship status.

stories.title: Carlos Alcaraz Wins Vienna Open to Claim Fourth Title of Season
stories.summary:
